statement: NVIDIA describes its own supply chain as one of the most complex globally, spanning millions of parts and thousands of suppliers, and is applying the AI stack there first.
why: The scale and complexity of NVIDIA's supplier base is the machinery behind accelerator lead times; efforts to optimise it bear on how quickly supply can respond.

impact.mechanism: Optimisation software applied to parts and supplier routing is aimed at improving visibility and decision-making across a chain that gates accelerator output.

evidence.excerpt: one of the most complex supply chains

confidence.basis: Primary source, but the claim is qualitative self-description with no parts, timing or throughput figures to measure against.
